title: Barack Obama launches podcast about books that ‘shaped his worldview’

paragraphs.en: Barack Obama is set to host a podcast about books that have “profoundly shaped his worldview and our society”, from Song of Solomon by Toni Morrison to Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy by John le Carré.
paragraphs.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马将主持一档播客，谈论那些“深刻塑造了他的世界观和我们的社会”的书籍，从托妮·莫里森的《所罗门之歌》到约翰·勒卡雷的《锅匠，裁缝，士兵，间谍》。

paragraphs.en: The podcast, called A Great Book with Barack Obama, will launch on Audible on 24 September.
paragraphs.zh: 这档名为《与巴拉克·奥巴马共读一本好书》的播客将于 9 月 24 日在 Audible 上线。

paragraphs.en: In each of six episodes – produced by the Amazon-owned company in collaboration with the Obamas’s production company Higher Ground – the former US president will discuss one of his chosen titles with a guest.
paragraphs.zh: 六集节目由亚马逊旗下公司与奥巴马夫妇的制片公司 Higher Ground 合作制作，每一集中，这位美国前总统都将与一位嘉宾讨论他挑选的一本书。

paragraphs.en: Along with the Morrison and le Carré, Obama has chosen The Fire Next Time by James Baldwin, All the Pretty Horses by Cormac McCarthy, Gilead by Marilynne Robinson, and All the King’s Men by Robert Penn Warren.
paragraphs.zh: 除了莫里森和勒卡雷的作品，奥巴马还挑选了詹姆斯·鲍德温的《下一次将是烈火》、科马克·麦卡锡的《天下骏马》、玛丽莲·罗宾逊的《基列家书》和罗伯特·佩恩·沃伦的《国王的人马》。

paragraphs.en: “Great books have always helped me figure out who I am and what I believe,” said Obama. “The six books featured in this series have stayed with me throughout my life, and each one has something to teach us about the human experience.
paragraphs.zh: “伟大的书籍一直帮助我认清我是谁、我相信什么，”奥巴马说，“这六本书在我一生中始终伴随着我，每一本都能让我们对人类体验有所领悟。”

paragraphs.en: “For this podcast, I invited some friends to explore why they resonate, how they can shape our understanding of ourselves and each other, and why literature matters now more than ever,” he said. “I hope listeners will be inspired to discover or rediscover books that change the way they see themselves and the world”. The podcast’s guests are yet to be announced.
paragraphs.zh: “在这档播客中，我邀请了一些朋友来探讨这些书为何能引起共鸣、它们如何塑造我们对自己以及彼此的理解，以及为什么文学在当下比以往任何时候都更重要，”他说，“我希望听众能被激发，去发现或重新发现那些能改变他们看待自己和世界方式的书籍。”播客的嘉宾名单尚未公布。

paragraphs.en: Obama has publicly shared his favourite books for years, posting summer reading lists and end-of-year roundups. This summer’s list, which he published in late July, includes Kin by Tayari Jones, Vigil by George Saunders, The Things We Never Say by Elizabeth Strout, Transcription by Ben Lerner, and Cool Machine by Colson Whitehead.
paragraphs.zh: 多年来，奥巴马一直公开分享他最喜欢的书，发布夏季书单和年终书单。今年夏天的书单于 7 月底发布，包括塔亚里·琼斯的《Kin》、乔治·桑德斯的《Vigil》、伊丽莎白·斯特劳特的《The Things We Never Say》、本·勒纳的《Transcription》和科尔森·怀特黑德的《Cool Machine》。

paragraphs.en: While his roundups are often made up of recently published books, all of his picks for his podcast were published in the 20th century, except for Robinson’s Gilead, released in 2004. Robinson and Obama struck up a correspondence after he invited her to dinner at the White House, and in 2012, he awarded her the National Humanities Medal.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然他的书单往往以近年出版的新书为主，但他为播客挑选的所有书目除罗宾逊 2004 年出版的《基列家书》外，都出版于 20 世纪。罗宾逊与奥巴马在他邀请她到白宫共进晚餐后开始了书信往来，2012 年，奥巴马授予她美国国家人文奖章。
